quarterly_data.quarter: Frencken Group business update: Business Update for 1Q26 (05-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 1Q26: revenue S$202.0 million (down 6.4%); semiconductor segment revenue eased 7.0% year-on-year to S$98.8 million, as robust growth at Mechatronics Asia from key front-end and back-end semiconductor equipment customers partly offset lower sales at Mechatronics Europe, which saw a moderation in orders of an advanced module for EUV systems from its peak level in 2025. Engagements with a key semiconductor customer reaffirm a recovery in Mechatronics Europe order flow from the second half of FY2026.
